name: Satake VBF Vertical Maize Degermer (Diagram 3 & 4a)
module: SAGMA Maize Milling Module 4: Mechanical Degermination & Flaking

parts.name: Grain Feed Inlet & Permanent Magnet
parts.feed: Conditioned whole maize inlet via gravity chute
parts.feedFlowDirection: Conditioned whole maize inlet via gravity chute
parts.specs: Feed capacity 2.0–7.0 t/h (VBF 5A: 2–3 t/h; VBF 7B: 3–4 t/h; VBF 10A: 4–7 t/h); high-intensity permanent plate/drum magnet.
parts.description: Conditioned whole maize enters the top inlet hopper. The permanent magnet catches tramp ferrous metal before entry, protecting internal slotted screens and high-speed rotor beaters from catastrophic impact damage.
parts.safety: Inspect magnet face at every shift stop. Never use bare hands to remove metal splinters to prevent severe lacerations.
parts.safetyNotice: Inspect magnet face at every shift stop. Never use bare hands to remove metal splinters to prevent severe lacerations.
parts.hazardDecal: CAUTION: RARE-EARTH MAGNET - PINCH & CUT HAZARD
parts.tolerance: Rare-earth magnetic trap rated >10,000 Gauss. Plate clearance 25 mm.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Rare-earth magnetic trap rated >10,000 Gauss. Plate clearance 25 mm.

parts.name: Motorized Inlet Screw Feeder & Compact Clutch
parts.officialName: Motorized Inlet Screw Feeder & Compact Clutch
parts.feed: Horizontal metered feed into lower housing
parts.feedFlowDirection: Horizontal metered feed into lower housing
parts.specs: Independent motorized variable-speed scroll drive; compact single-unit scroll design.
parts.description: A horizontal motorized feed screw propels incoming maize into the lower housing, automatically regulating feed volume based on main motor ammeter load.
parts.safety: Electrically interlocked with main motor ammeter load; automatically halts feed upon current overload spikes.
parts.safetyNotice: Electrically interlocked with main motor ammeter load; automatically halts feed upon current overload spikes.
parts.hazardDecal: WARNING: AUTOMATIC AUGER ROTATION - KEEP CLEAR
parts.tolerance: Variable flight pitch 65 mm. Radial barrel flight clearance: 2.0 mm (+/- 0.5 mm).
parts.engineeringTolerance: Variable flight pitch 65 mm. Radial barrel flight clearance: 2.0 mm (+/- 0.5 mm).

parts.name: Vertical Distribution Scroll
parts.feed: Vertical upward propulsion into scouring chamber
parts.feedFlowDirection: Vertical upward propulsion into scouring chamber
parts.specs: Heavy-duty cast-iron vertical spiral scroll attached to the lower rotor shaft.
parts.description: Positioned at the base of the scouring chamber, this rotating spiral scroll catches incoming grain from the feed screw and forces it vertically upward into the narrow friction chamber against gravity.
parts.safety: Lock-Out / Tag-Out (LOTO) mandatory before manual cleanout of lower scroll intake cavity.
parts.safetyNotice: Lock-Out / Tag-Out (LOTO) mandatory before manual cleanout of lower scroll intake cavity.
parts.hazardDecal: DANGER: CONFINED ROTATING SPIRAL PINCH ZONE
parts.tolerance: Spiral flight lead angle: 18 deg. Bottom throat radial clearance: 3.5 mm nominal.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Spiral flight lead angle: 18 deg. Bottom throat radial clearance: 3.5 mm nominal.

parts.name: Cylindrical Steel Rotor (Split Segment Design)
parts.specs: Smooth cylindrical steel rotor operating at 465 RPM; split segment design (dismantles into two halves for maintenance).
parts.description: Revolves vertically inside the screen cylinder to turn the bed of grain, creating intense kernel-to-kernel and kernel-to-screen friction to peel outer pericarp (bran) skins and detach the germ.
parts.safety: Lock-Out / Tag-Out (LOTO) mandatory before opening access panels; contact with the revolving rotor causes severe injury.
parts.safetyNotice: Lock-Out / Tag-Out (LOTO) mandatory before opening access panels; contact with the revolving rotor causes severe injury.
parts.hazardDecal: DANGER: HIGH-TORQUE ROTATING CYLINDER - LOTO MANDATORY
parts.tolerance: Rotor dynamic balance tolerance: < 2.5 g mm/kg. Operating velocity: 465 RPM (+/- 5 RPM).
parts.engineeringTolerance: Rotor dynamic balance tolerance: < 2.5 g mm/kg. Operating velocity: 465 RPM (+/- 5 RPM).

parts.name: Detachable Steel Beater Bars (Qty 2)
parts.feed: Radial grain agitation and tumbling across screens
parts.feedFlowDirection: Radial grain agitation and tumbling across screens
parts.specs: Two hardened-steel, rigid impact/agitator bars mounted on opposite sides of the rotor.
parts.description: Extends the full height of the rotor. As the rotor turns at 465 RPM, these beaters tumble rising maize kernels against the slotted screens, popping the germ free from its cavity with minimal endosperm flouring.
parts.safety: Verify beater bar mounting bolt torque (85 Nm) and check for edge wear before closing screen housing.
parts.safetyNotice: Verify beater bar mounting bolt torque (85 Nm) and check for edge wear before closing screen housing.
parts.hazardDecal: CAUTION: HARDENED IMPACT BARS - CHECK BOLT TORQUE
parts.tolerance: Dual-opposed mounting at 180 deg. Radial tip-to-screen clearance: 11.0 mm (+/- 1.0 mm).
parts.engineeringTolerance: Dual-opposed mounting at 180 deg. Radial tip-to-screen clearance: 11.0 mm (+/- 1.0 mm).

parts.name: Multifaceted Slotted Screen Cartridge & Rib Cage
parts.officialName: Multifaceted Slotted Screen Cartridge & Rib Cage
parts.feed: Pericarp (bran) and germ offal aspiration exit
parts.feedFlowDirection: Pericarp (bran) and germ offal aspiration exit
parts.specs: 8 multifaceted vertical slotted screen panels enclosed in a heavy-gauge steel rib cage and outer clamping frames.
parts.description: Encloses the scouring chamber. The slotted apertures allow scoured bran, light germ snips, and attrition dust to pass into the exhaust hood while retaining larger debranned endosperm kernels (samp) inside.
parts.safety: Inspect screen apertures regularly for foreign object damage or wear. Use protective gloves to handle sharp edges.
parts.safetyNotice: Inspect screen apertures regularly for foreign object damage or wear. Use protective gloves to handle sharp edges.
parts.tolerance: 8-segment polygonal cage. Slotted aperture width: 1.0 mm x 12.0 mm (calibrated for maize).
parts.engineeringTolerance: 8-segment polygonal cage. Slotted aperture width: 1.0 mm x 12.0 mm (calibrated for maize).

parts.name: Independently Adjustable Resistance Bars
parts.specs: Rigid alloy resistance bars mounted inside the screen jacket with external adjusting bolts.
parts.description: Positioned along the vertical screen walls, these bars retard the swirling movement of grain, increasing internal friction severity to match specific maize hardness or moisture conditions.
parts.safety: Adjust resistance bolts evenly across all quadrants to prevent uneven screen barrel pressure.
parts.safetyNotice: Adjust resistance bolts evenly across all quadrants to prevent uneven screen barrel pressure.
parts.tolerance: External adjusting screw travel: 0–15 mm protrusion into grain stream.
parts.engineeringTolerance: External adjusting screw travel: 0–15 mm protrusion into grain stream.

parts.name: Overtails Discharge Chute & Weighted Retention Flap
parts.officialName: Overtails Discharge Chute & Weighted Retention Flap
parts.specs: Counter-weighted hinged discharge gate with optional CCU Auto-Weight control module.
parts.description: Located at the top outlet. Retards the exit of debranned maize to maintain the exact internal pressure required for complete degerming; the auto-weight module monitors motor amperage to adjust pressure dynamically.
parts.safety: Keep hands clear of discharge flap mechanism during automatic CCU modulation.
parts.safetyNotice: Keep hands clear of discharge flap mechanism during automatic CCU modulation.
parts.hazardDecal: WARNING: AUTOMATIC PRESSURE FLAP PINCH POINT
parts.tolerance: Flap counterweight moment arm: 250 mm. Gate seal clearance: 1.5 mm neoprene cushion.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Flap counterweight moment arm: 250 mm. Gate seal clearance: 1.5 mm neoprene cushion.

parts.name: Air Induction Fan & Central Hollow Rotor Duct
parts.officialName: Air Induction Fan & Central Hollow Rotor Duct
parts.feed: Forced internal cooling air injection through rotor slots
parts.feedFlowDirection: Forced internal cooling air injection through rotor slots
parts.specs: Central hollow drive shaft with air discharge slots located directly behind each beater bar; negative pressure pneumatic exhaust ducting.
parts.description: The fan forces cool air down through the hollow drive shaft and out behind the beater bars, sweeping across the grain bed to cool stock and carry loose bran and germ through the slotted screens into the offal exhaust.
parts.safety: Verify negative pressure airflow before starting feed to prevent dust accumulation and overheating.
parts.safetyNotice: Verify negative pressure airflow before starting feed to prevent dust accumulation and overheating.
parts.hazardDecal: CAUTION: PNEUMATIC AIR FLOW - ROTATING IMPELLER
parts.tolerance: Air volume required: 30–45 m3/min @ 120–150 mm WG static negative pressure.
parts.engineeringTolerance: Air volume required: 30–45 m3/min @ 120–150 mm WG static negative pressure.

parts.name: Machine Base Frame & 75 kW Main Belt Drive
parts.officialName: Machine Base Frame & 75 kW Main Belt Drive
parts.feed: Torque transmission to vertical rotor shaft @ 465 RPM
parts.feedFlowDirection: Torque transmission to vertical rotor shaft @ 465 RPM
parts.specs: Bottom-mounted 75 kW electric motor (3-Phase, 50 Hz); multi-V-belt drive with heavy protective guard enclosure.
parts.description: Cast-steel base frame housing bottom thrust bearings and drive pulleys, supplying rotational power to drive the vertical rotor shaft at 465 RPM under heavy friction loading.
parts.safety: V-belt guards must remain securely bolted at all times during operation.
parts.safetyNotice: V-belt guards must remain securely bolted at all times during operation.
parts.hazardDecal: DANGER: HIGH-POWER 75 kW BELT DRIVE - GUARDS MANDATORY
parts.tolerance: Motor: 75 kW, 1,480 RPM nominal. Multi V-belt reduction ratio: 3.18:1 (output 465 RPM).
parts.engineeringTolerance: Motor: 75 kW, 1,480 RPM nominal. Multi V-belt reduction ratio: 3.18:1 (output 465 RPM).
